idea: AI-powered document processing for small businesses (invoices, contracts, receipts)

selected_gap.title: AI-powered document processing for small businesses (invoices, contracts, receipts)
selected_gap.pain: Small businesses manually enter data from documents into accounting/ERP systems; existing OCR tools are inaccurate or expensive.
selected_gap.why_now: Advances in LLMs and vision AI make accurate extraction feasible at low cost.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: Survey of 50 small business owners on time spent on data entry; test accuracy of current AI models on sample documents.
selected_gap.risk: Competition from generic AI document parsers (e.g., Rossum, Hyperscience).

yc_rule_scores.rule: Do not wait for the perfect idea
Build at the edge of AI
Do not bolt AI onto legacy
Cover domain, model, and operations fluency

decision: No-go. Insufficient founder-market fit and high competition; need deeper validation before committing.
next_experiments: Conduct survey of 50 small business owners to quantify time spent on data entry and willingness to pay.
Build a low-fidelity demo using existing AI models and test extraction accuracy on 100 sample invoices/receipts.
Interview 10 small business owners to understand current workflow, trust issues, and pain points.
kill_criteria: Less than 40% of survey respondents willing to pay >$50/month.
AI model accuracy below 80% on key document types (invoices, receipts, contracts).
Competitor offering similar solution at comparable price with significant adoption in target segment.
